def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    # --- Товары: продажи строго до seed_time ---
    work = order_items[(order_items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids))
                       & (order_items['ts'] < seed_time)].copy()

    # --- Заказы, "видимые" на seed_time: покупка до seed_time ---
    visible_orders = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time]
    # доступная на момент seed_time информация о статусе/доставке:
    # даты доставки учитываем только если они <= seed_time (иначе ещё не известно)
    visible_orders = visible_orders.copy()
    for col in ['order_approved_at', 'order_delivered_carrier_date',
                'order_delivered_customer_date', 'order_estimated_delivery_date']:
        visible_orders.loc[visible_orders[col] > seed_time, col] = pd.NaT

    # --- Отзывы: только те, что уже созданы к seed_time ---
    visible_reviews = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time][
        ['order_id', 'review_score']].drop_duplicates(subset='order_id')

    # --- Платежи: только по видимым заказам ---
    visible_payments = payments[payments['order_id'].isin(visible_orders['order_id'])]

    result = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'))

    empty = len(work) == 0

    # ---------- Признаки за всё время ----------
    if not empty:
        total_grp = work.groupby('product_id').agg(
            orders_total=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            units_total=('order_item_id', 'count'),
            price_total=('price', 'sum'),
            freight_total=('freight_value', 'sum'),
            price_avg=('price', 'mean'),
            freight_avg=('freight_value', 'mean'),
            first_sale=('ts', 'min'),
            last_sale=('ts', 'max'),
        )
        total_grp['age_days'] = (seed_time - total_grp['first_sale']).dt.days
        total_grp['days_since_last'] = (seed_time - total_grp['last_sale']).dt.days
        total_grp['sales_span_days'] = (total_grp['last_sale'] - total_grp['first_sale']).dt.days
        total_grp['orders_per_month'] = total_grp['orders_total'] / ((total_grp['age_days'] / 30.0).clip(lower=1))
        total_grp = total_grp.drop(columns=['first_sale', 'last_sale'])

        # отзывы (только видимые на seed_time)
        wr = work.merge(visible_reviews, on='order_id', how='left')
        rev_grp = wr.groupby('product_id').agg(
            review_avg=('review_score', 'mean'),
            review_cnt=('review_score', 'count'),
        )

        # платежи (только видимые заказы)
        wp = work.merge(visible_payments[['order_id', 'payment_value', 'payment_installments']],
                        on='order_id', how='left')
        pay_grp = wp.groupby('product_id').agg(
            pay_total=('payment_value', 'sum'),
            pay_installments_avg=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
        )

        feat = total_grp.join(rev_grp, how='left').join(pay_grp, how='left')
        for col in feat.columns:
            result[col] = feat[col].reindex(entity_ids)
    else:
        for col in ['orders_total', 'units_total', 'price_total', 'freight_total',
                    'price_avg', 'freight_avg', 'age_days', 'days_since_last',
                    'sales_span_days', 'orders_per_month',
                    'review_avg', 'review_cnt', 'pay_total', 'pay_installments_avg']:
            result[col] = np.nan

    # ---------- Временные окна ----------
    windows = [7, 30, 90, 180, 365]
    for w in windows:
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=w)
        ww = work[work['ts'] >= cutoff]
        if len(ww) > 0:
            grp = ww.groupby('product_id').agg(
                orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
                items=('order_item_id', 'count'),
                price=('price', 'sum'),
                freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
            )
            grp.columns = [f'{c}_{w}d' for c in grp.columns]
            for col in grp.columns:
                result[col] = grp[col].reindex(entity_ids)
        else:
            for c in ['orders', 'items', 'price', 'freight']:
                result[f'{c}_{w}d'] = np.nan

        # тренд: продажи в окне w относительно предыдущего окна такой же длины
        prev_start = cutoff - pd.Timedelta(days=w)
        wp = work[(work['ts'] >= prev_start) & (work['ts'] < cutoff)]
        if len(wp) > 0:
            prev_grp = wp.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
            result[f'orders_prev_{w}d'] = prev_grp.reindex(entity_ids)
        else:
            result[f'orders_prev_{w}d'] = np.nan
        cur = result.get(f'orders_{w}d')
        prev = result[f'orders_prev_{w}d']
        with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
            ratio = (cur - prev) / (prev + 1.0)
        result[f'orders_trend_{w}d'] = ratio.fillna(0.0)

    # ---------- Отзывы за последние 90 дней ----------
    cutoff_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    w90 = work[work['ts'] >= cutoff_90]
    if len(w90) > 0:
        wr90 = w90.merge(visible_reviews, on='order_id', how='left')
        g = wr90.groupby('product_id').agg(
            review_avg_90d=('review_score', 'mean'),
            review_cnt_90d=('review_score', 'count'),
        )
        for col in g.columns:
            result[col] = g[col].reindex(entity_ids)
    else:
        result['review_avg_90d'] = np.nan
        result['review_cnt_90d'] = np.nan

    # ---------- Доставочные признаки (только доставленное к seed_time) ----------
    deliv = visible_orders[['order_id', 'order_delivered_customer_date',
                            'order_estimated_delivery_date']].dropna(
        subset=['order_delivered_customer_date'])
    if len(deliv) > 0 and not empty:
        wd = work.merge(deliv, on='order_id', how='inner')
        if len(wd) > 0:
            wd['delay_days'] = (wd['order_delivered_customer_date'] -
                                wd['order_estimated_delivery_date']).dt.days
            g = wd.groupby('product_id').agg(
                delivery_delay_avg=('delay_days', 'mean'),
                delivered_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            )
            for col in g.columns:
                result[col] = g[col].reindex(entity_ids)
        else:
            result['delivery_delay_avg'] = np.nan
            result['delivered_orders'] = np.nan
    else:
        result['delivery_delay_avg'] = np.nan
        result['delivered_orders'] = np.nan

    # ---------- Финальная очистка ----------
    result = result.reindex(entity_ids)
    result = result.astype(float).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    return result
